name: Regulatory DNA sites, inputs and measured-output correspondence
description: Compare exact regulatory DNA sequences and mapped promoters, expose motif matches under a supplied model, and retain separate binding, molecular-input/state and transcription-output records.

capability_operations.operation: Compare selected operator or promoter sequences

inputs.sequences: identified oligonucleotides or genomic intervals with strand/coordinates
inputs.correspondence: declared common reference and positional convention

outputs.differences: exact substitutions, indels and motif-position correspondence
outputs.scope: selected sites only, without an inferred regulon

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Scan supplied sequences with an explicit motif model

outputs.matches: positions, strands, model scores and conditional p/qvalues

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Join source records at exact target/condition identities

inputs.records: separate binding, reporter/transcript, abundance and protein-state observations
inputs.keys: actual target/promoter variant, protein state, sample and assay condition

outputs.table: measured links and unmatched observations; activation/repression only when directly recorded

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: sequence.align/sites, public.ncbi.sequence and reference.neighborhood provide general sequence/feature primitives. No FIMO or regulator-inference callable confirmed in repository catalog.
research_operations_performed: root/regulatory_specificity/raw/iscr_comparison_probe.json: seven published 30-mer oligos compared at exact positions; selected source competition ratios calculated.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: FIMO was identified from official documentation as a motif+FASTA scanner, but it was not executed and its installation/registry binding was not established. New regulon reconstruction is not supplied.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: DNA-binding, footprinting, reporter, redox-treatment and metal/cofactor measurements remain author experiments.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: A motif match supplies a model-based candidate site, not regulatory direction or a productive cellular effect.
A bound site can have no detected output in tested conditions; affinity at one site does not measure exclusion of other targets.
An environmental treatment can act through a cofactor/feedback route; it does not establish direct ligand binding to the regulator.

observed_uses.use: Actual oligo and source comparisons separated altered target recognition, preserved single-site affinity, nonfunctional footprinted sites and promoter-specific output.
observed_uses.execution_scope: No new motif scan, regulon, intracellular state quantification or binding assay.
